references.text: Here the crowd repeats the accusation that Jesus has an evil spirit, even though the question of who seeks to kill him does not appear in this specific verse.
Here the Jews express that Jesus is possessed and out of his mind, which mirrors the accusation of demon possession in John 7:20, but the question about murder plans is missing in this verse.
For the first time, the crowd in Jerusalem discusses whether Jesus is the one they seek to kill, and they ask who has started looking for him to kill him.
From this moment on, they plan to kill Jesus, confirming that there was a real conspiracy to kill him, as the crowd in John 7:20 had hinted.
The Jews had already sought earlier to kill Jesus because he broke the Sabbath, which provides context for the question of who seeks to kill him in John 7:20.
